title: Consecration and the Journey Begins

questions.question: What did God command Israel to consecrate to Him?
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:2 (ESV): "Consecrate to me all the firstborn. Whatever is the first to open the womb among the people of Israel, both of man and of beast, is mine."

questions.question: What feast did God tell Israel to remember annually?
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:6-7 (ESV): "Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a feast to the Lord."

questions.question: What did Moses take with him when leaving Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:19 (ESV): "Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for Joseph had made the sons of Israel solemnly swear."

questions.question: How did God lead the Israelites by day and night?
options: By a pillar of cloud and fire
questions.correctAnswer: By a pillar of cloud and fire
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:21 (ESV): "The Lord went before them by day in a pillar of cloud to lead them along the way, and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light."

questions.question: Why did God lead Israel by the wilderness route instead of through Philistia?
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:17 (ESV): "God did not lead them by way of the land of the Philistines...lest the people change their minds when they see war and return to Egypt."

questions.question: How many days were they to eat unleavened bread?
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:6 (ESV): "Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread."

questions.question: What was to be done with a firstborn donkey?
options: Redeem it with a lamb, or break its neck
questions.correctAnswer: Redeem it with a lamb, or break its neck
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:13 (ESV): "Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb, or if you will not redeem it you shall break its neck."

questions.question: What were parents told to say when their children asked about this observance?
options: By a strong hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: By a strong hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:14 (ESV): "You shall say to him, 'By a strong hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt, from the house of slavery.'"

questions.question: Where did the Israelites camp after leaving Succoth?
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:20 (ESV): "And they moved on from Succoth and encamped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness."

questions.question: What was the purpose of the pillar of cloud and fire?
options: To lead them and give light so they could travel day and night
questions.correctAnswer: To lead them and give light so they could travel day and night
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:21 (ESV): "To lead them along the way, and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, that they might travel by day and by night."

questions.question: What month was the Feast of Unleavened Bread to be kept?
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:4 (ESV): "Today, in the month of Abib, you are going out."

questions.question: What was the observance to be like on their hand and between their eyes?
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:9 (ESV): "And it shall be to you as a sign on your hand and as a memorial between your eyes."

questions.question: Why did God kill every firstborn in Egypt according to Moses' explanation?
options: Because Pharaoh refused to let Israel go
questions.correctAnswer: Because Pharaoh refused to let Israel go
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:15 (ESV): "For when Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the Lord killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt."

questions.question: Did the pillar of cloud and fire ever leave the people?
options: No, the pillar of cloud by day and fire by night did not depart
questions.correctAnswer: No, the pillar of cloud by day and fire by night did not depart
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:22 (ESV): "The pillar of cloud by day and the pillar of fire by night did not depart from before the people."

questions.question: How were firstborn sons to be handled?
options: All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem
questions.correctAnswer: All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem
questions.explanation: Exodus 13:13 (ESV): "Every firstborn of man among your sons you shall redeem."

key_verse_text: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of cloud to lead them along the way, and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, that they might travel by day and by night.
